thread:
anya: FYI i pulled a billing incident for beta-corp - spike during a streaming reconnect. looks like prefetch sidecar involvement + truncation edge. pinging infra and billing.

anya: numbers: console shows charge of 3900 tokens in one ledger event but emitted token trace is ~1750. that's ~2.2x.

lee: can you drop the request id and a few lines from the router/ledger logs?

anya: request=r-9f8e7d6c model=redwood-open-7b prefetch=true stream=true truncation=server@1024

anya: logs:
```
2026-03-21T08:12:01Z INFO router:session_start id=r-9f8e7d6c session=sess-41 route=/api/v1/generate
2026-03-21T08:12:05Z INFO sidecar:prefetch_hit id=r-9f8e7d6c node=prefetch-sidecar
2026-03-21T08:12:06Z WARN network:conn_lost id=r-9f8e7d6c
2026-03-21T08:12:07Z INFO router:rejoin id=r-9f8e7d6c session=sess-41
2026-03-21T08:12:08Z INFO model:truncated id=r-9f8e7d6c truncated_at=1024
2026-03-21T08:12:09Z INFO ledger:emit id=r-9f8e7d6c tokens=3900 attribution=unknown
```

sam: hmm ledger attribution=unknown — that smells like sidecar and main both emitting without a shared session tag.

marta: we had a similar bug where toolcall suffixes were incorrectly given new session ids on resume, causing two ledger writes. iirc we fixed part of it by carrying origin_session in rpc headers.

lee: do we have router handoff records showing which path completed the work?

anya: router shows handoff to prefetch-sidecar then back to main-worker on reconnect. no variant swap.

kai: ops-bot: there was a routing change earlier this week that enabled prefetch-sidecar for long sessions (PR #1127). could be interacting with truncation boundary.

sam: two hypotheses: 1) sidecar emitted provisional ledger before reconnect and main emitted final after truncate, double-charge, or 2) billing pipeline dedupe key relies on request_id only and reconnect resets something.

marta: mitigation proposals: a) add session_id to all ledger events, b) have sidecar set provisional flag so billing knows to reconcile with final event, c) console highlight when truncation+prefetch present and token_ratio > 1.5.

lee: i like (a) + (c). (b) adds workflow complexity. also we should add quick trace links right from charge detail.

anya: i'll open ENG-PLAT-9902 and include logs + suggested dashboard tile. also will add a quick query to compute token_ratio = ledger_tokens / trace_tokens per-session for last 12h.

kai: ops-bot: created feature-flag ff:prefetch-session-id (off). can enable in canary cluster tomorrow at 06:30 UTC.

sam: rollout notes: start by emitting session_id everywhere but keep dedupe fallback unchanged. monitor token_ratio metric for 24h, then flip dedupe to use session_id+seq if stable.

marta: add a unit e2e test simulating reconnect+prefetch+truncate asserting single ledger event emitted. i'll own the test.

lee: i'll update console UX to show last router path in the charge inspector and add a callout when prefetch+truncate detected.

anya: thanks all. priority: triage, canary the flag, run metric dashboard, file customer support note for beta-corp. i'll attach the ticket to the incident.
